name: Adaptive Ray Marching with Macrocell DDA
definition: A ray marching algorithm that uses a 3D DDA (Digital Differential Analyzer) to traverse macrocells of a volume. It adapts the sampling step size based on an opacity upper bound estimate for the current macrocell to skip empty or low-opacity regions.
summary: Adaptive Ray Marching with Macrocell DDA is a volume rendering technique that uses a 3D DDA to traverse macrocells, dynamically adjusting step sizes based on opacity bounds to skip empty regions and optimize sampling within occupied ones.
